 NFC North Mock Draft: Making picks ahead of Week 9
 Andrew Harbaugh, Vikings Wire 2026년 11월 8일 일 오후 2:55 UTC 0 With the ninth week of the NFL season now underway, we are locking back into one of our favorite series on Vikings Wire: NFC North Mock Drafts.
 Of course, Mock Draft Monday will still focus on the team itself, but what will the other teams in the division need come next April? We look at that and do three-round mock drafts for every team in the NFC North, not just the  Minnesota Vikings . By doing that, it accomplishes two things: the first is that fans get to know what the team needs and what the other opponents in the division have, but also, you get to know more names in college football.
 Advertisement
 With that in mind, let's jump into the picks as we go through the uber-talented NFC North.
 Chicago Bears 
 Round 2: Sebastian Cheeks, Edge, Wisconsin
 Round 3: Qua Moss, CB, Tennessee
 Detroit Lions 
 Round 1: Kingston Lopa, S, California
 Round 2: Sammy Brown, LB, Clemson
 Round 3: DJ McKinney, CB, Notre Dame
 Green Bay Packers 
 Round 2: Jalen Mayo, CB, Houston
 Round 3: Anthony Boswell, C, Houston
 Round 3: Desmeal Leigh, OT, Youngstown State
 Minnesota Vikings 
 Round 1: Trinidad Chambliss, QB, Ole Miss 
 Round 2 : John Henry Daley, Edge, Michigan
 Round 3: LJ Martin, RB, BYU
 Round 3: Ty Benefield, S, LSU
